name: cmdb_cientity
label: CMDB
description: The CMDB configuration item instance table stores instance data for configuration items (CIs) in the enterprise IT infrastructure. Each record represents a specific configuration object, such as a server, database, middleware instance, or application system. Main fields: • id: unique identifier of the configuration item instance. • ci_id: references the primary key of the configuration item definition table (cmdb_ci) to determine the configuration item type. • name: configuration item name or host name. • status: current configuration item status, such as active, inactive, or under maintenance. • is_locked: indicates whether the configuration item is locked by a transaction to control concurrent changes. • inspect_status / inspect_time: inspection task result and time. • monitor_status / monitor_time: latest monitoring task status and update time. • renew_time: most recent refresh time of the configuration item, used to determine whether the data is stale. • fcu / fcd / lcu / lcd: creator, creation time, modifier, and modification time, respectively. Typical uses: • provides the core data source for the CMDB (configuration management database). • supports reports for asset inventory, monitoring and alerts, automated inspection, and configuration audits. Key indexes: • ci_id index: supports queries by configuration item type. • name_prefix index: supports fuzzy name searches. This table supports status tracking, time-based statistics, relational queries, and other configuration management reporting scenarios.
